records.title: Speculative Correction: Draft-then-Refine Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: The abstract presents draft/refine speculative correction for diffusion language-model decoding and reports speed improvements.

records.title: Speculative Probing: LLM Monitoring at Speculative-Decoding Cost
records.reason: The abstract reuses speculative-decoding machinery and resident KV cache for low-overhead real-time LLM monitoring, a direct inference systems mechanism.

records.title: BudgetMem: Training-Free Selective Memory for Cost-Efficient Long-Context Processing in Language Models
records.reason: The arXiv-issued DOI resolves to arXiv:2511.04919; its abstract describes selective memory that reduces retained context and processing cost.

records.title: SparseLLM: Towards Global Pruning of Pre-trained Language Models
records.reason: The abstract describes global pruning for pretrained LLMs to reduce computation and memory, directly connected to model compression.

records.title: Accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models by Searching Optimal Vision Token Reduction
records.reason: The abstract proposes visual-token reduction for MLLMs and reports inference acceleration, directly relevant to multimodal LLM serving.

records.title: DenoiseRotator: Enhance Pruning Robustness for LLMs via Importance Concentration
records.reason: The abstract makes LLM weight representations more amenable to pruning, a direct model-compression method.

records.title: VisionSelector: End-to-End Learnable Visual Token Compression for Efficient Multimodal LLMs
records.reason: The abstract compresses visual tokens in MLLMs and reports prefill-speed improvement, directly targeting multimodal inference cost.

records.title: Key and Value Weights Are Probably All You Need: On the Necessity of the Query, Key, Value weight Triplet in Self-Attention Transformers
records.reason: The arXiv abstract proves one attention projection can be redundant, reducing attention parameters by 25% while preserving model performance in decoder-only GPT-style models.

records.title: Scalable LLM Agent Tool Access in the Cloud
records.reason: The arXiv abstract describes a cloud-scale MCP gateway that lowers tool-selection time and token usage, directly addressing agent inference overhead and serving scale.

records.title: Yuan3.0 Ultra: A Trillion-Parameter Enterprise-Oriented MoE LLM
records.reason: The arXiv abstract describes Layer-Adaptive Expert Pruning for the pre-training stage and reports pre-training efficiency only; it does not establish an inference/serving efficiency method.
